title: MouseWithoutBorders Won't connect (I found the root cause but it's not something I can fix)

judgment.rationale: The reporter identifies the existing issue and its detailed same-release/Store evidence supports consolidating the settings-sync failure there. This does not independently prove every connection failure has that cause, and50795 remains open. Avoid a competing design or unsafe signature-check bypass.
evidence: The Store-release report says pairing key changes do not persist in the bundled Mouse Without Borders while the standalone tool connects. The reporter subsequently links existing issue50795 and reports differing signer thumbprints.

The supplied screenshot was inspected. It shows Get-AuthenticodeSignature results marked Valid for Settings and Mouse Without Borders, but an overlapping window obscures the thumbprints. The screenshot does not independently establish the hidden values or provide a downloadable diagnostic log.

Open issue50795 and all six comments were read. They include matching settings-sync untrusted-signature failures and valid-but-different Microsoft signer certificates in0.102.3001, including a Store installation. The existing thread also records key-sync failures and absent status colors.

At shipped tagv0.102.3001, NamedPipePeerVerification.MeetsSigningPolicy invokes trusted-signer matching, and HaveMatchingSignerCertificate compares the leaf certificate RawData using FixedTimeEquals. A valid Microsoft signature alone does not satisfy this equality check.

The new report has no assignee, posted maintainer evidence request or linked implementing PR. Focused PR search found no covering PR for50795; this is existing issue coverage, not a confirmed shipped fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: Existing open issue50795 covers the reported signer/settings-sync mechanism. This field records existing coverage only: no implementing PR or released fix is established.

comment.body: Thanks for finding #50795. It already tracks the same valid-but-different Microsoft signing certificates preventing Settings from synchronizing with Mouse Without Borders, including reports on 0.102.3001 and the Microsoft Store installation. That fits the pairing-key changes not reaching the bundled engine. We should consolidate this report there rather than start another fix investigation. The covering issue is still open; this is not a claim that the problem is fixed. Please do not share pairing keys or private settings, or bypass signature validation. A separate transport failure would need to be distinguished if connection still fails after settings synchronization is restored.

inferences: The same settings-sync rejection is a strong explanation for unsaved pairing changes, but this report does not include its own readable log confirming the rejection or rule out an independent network problem.
issue_context.summary: Likely duplicate of the existing valid-but-different signer certificate settings-sync report; the covering issue remains unresolved.

information_gaps.how_to_collect: First consolidate into50795 using existing same-release evidence. If later needed, capture packaged diagnostics with /bugreport immediately after reproduction; never post pairing keys or private settings.
information_gaps.information: Whether the same settings-sync rejection is present in this specific installation
information_gaps.why_needed: Differentiate the covered settings-sync failure from a separate transport problem if it persists after the covering issue is addressed.
